about: DICE-TOOL-01: language-neutral cases for free dice rolls (reference: sim/dice_tool.py). 'dice' are the scripted faces in the order the dice are rolled (left to right). A port passes when it gives the same expr, total, natural and text, or the same error.

cases.name: a plain d20 with a bonus
cases.label: Perception

cases.name: d20 means one die; spaces and case do not matter
disadvantage keeps the lower d20, a natural 1
equal dice: the first one is kept
an ability score: 4d6 keep the highest 3
Bless rides along with a d20 test
DICE-POOL-01: mixed dice and a bonus
DICE-POOL-01: four dice sizes, a penalty and the largest bonus

Dice: only d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 and d100.
